subject: The corroboration guard is theatre as written (R119b): two evaluations 30s apart satisfy it, which is NOT independent evidence — at a 5h rollover both samples sit on the same side of it. So it blocks the honest single-call path while being trivially bypassable by calling twice
done_when: two samples must be at least a minimum interval apart to count as corroboration; a test proves two rapid readings are refused

notes.text: fixed with #143 — same root cause: burn-down writing its own samples both starved it AND made the guard bypassable. It now READS only, and requires BURNDOWN_SAMPLE_MIN_GAP (120s) between the two readings.
